annotations.title: SQL DDL to Type-Safe ORM Entity Compiler (Prisma, Drizzle, Zod)

description: Compiles SQL DDL schemas into type-safe ORM entities and TypeScript validation schemas (Prisma, Drizzle, SQLAlchemy, Zod). Use when scaffolding application models, generating TypeScript data layers, or synchronizing schemas; for translating raw SQL across dialects, use transpile_sql_dialect instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'schema_ddl' ('orm_target' defaults to 'drizzle_orm_typescript'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

include_relations.description: Whether to generate explicit foreign key relation decorators and navigation properties.

orm_target.description: Target ORM framework standard: Prisma schema, Drizzle ORM TypeScript, SQLAlchemy Python 2.0, or Zod types.

schema_ddl.description: Database schema DDL statements defining tables, primary keys, and relationships.

name: generate_orm_models

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for generate_orm_models.

compiled_code.description: Generated type-safe model code matching the specified ORM or validation schema framework.

models_generated.description: List of model entity names successfully parsed and compiled from the schema.

orm_framework.description: Name of the target ORM framework output produced.
